description.text: Let \(f:X\to Z\) and \(g:Y\to Z\) be continuous, with \(Z\) Hausdorff. The fiber product is closed because equality of the two images is membership in the closed diagonal of \(Z\times Z\). The equalizer lemma used by the Lean proof packages the diagonal and inverse-image steps.
description.author: Codex companion

variables: Let \(h=f\times g:X\times Y\to Z\times Z\), \(h(x,y)=(f(x),g(y))\), and \(\Delta_Z(z)=(z,z)\).
Let \(p_X:X\times Y\to X\) and \(p_Y:X\times Y\to Y\) be the product projections; put \(u=f\circ p_X\) and \(v=g\circ p_Y\).

explanation.text: This hypothesis makes the diagonal closed.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Composition with \(p_X\) gives a continuous map on the product.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Composition with \(p_Y\) gives the second continuous map on the product.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Product projections
nodes.claim: The product projections \(p_X\) and \(p_Y\) are continuous.

explanation.text: The product topology supplies these two maps.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: 08ZE: diagonal criterion
nodes.claim: For a topological space \(Z\), Hausdorffness is equivalent to closedness of \(\Delta_Z(Z)\subseteq Z\times Z\).

explanation.text: Only the forward implication is needed for 08ZH.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Closed inverse images
nodes.claim: The inverse image of a closed set under a continuous map is closed.

explanation.text: This converts continuity of \(h\) and closedness of the diagonal into a closed subset of \(X\times Y\).
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Closed equalizers
nodes.claim: If \(A\) is a topological space, \(Z\) is Hausdorff, and \(u,v:A\to Z\) are continuous, then \(\{a\in A:u(a)=v(a)\}\) is closed.

explanation.text: Mathlib proves this using the continuous pair map \(a\mapsto(u(a),v(a))\) and the closed diagonal. It packages the inverse-image argument.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: This identifies the fiber product with the equalizer of \(u\) and \(v\).
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Closed diagonal
nodes.claim: The set \(\Delta_Z(Z)\) is closed in \(Z\times Z\).

explanation.text: Apply the forward implication of 08ZE to the Hausdorff target \(Z\).
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Continuity of u
nodes.claim: The map \(u=f\circ p_X:X\times Y\to Z\) is continuous.

explanation.text: Use continuity of \(f\) and \(p_X\) jointly.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Continuity of v
nodes.claim: The map \(v=g\circ p_Y:X\times Y\to Z\) is continuous.

explanation.text: Use continuity of \(g\) and \(p_Y\) jointly.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Continuity of h
nodes.claim: The map \(h=f\times g:X\times Y\to Z\times Z\) is continuous.

explanation.text: Its coordinate maps are \(u\) and \(v\), so the product-topology criterion applies.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Inverse-image identity
nodes.claim: For \((x,y)\in X\times Y\), \((x,y)\in h^{-1}(\Delta_Z(Z))\) if and only if \(f(x)=g(y)\), if and only if \((x,y)\in F\). Thus \(F=h^{-1}(\Delta_Z(Z))\).

explanation.text: The defining equality of the fiber product is precisely membership of the image pair in the diagonal.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: Closed equalizer set
nodes.claim: The set \(E=\{(x,y)\in X\times Y:u(x,y)=v(x,y)\}\) is closed.

explanation.text: Apply isClosed_eq to \(u\) and \(v\), using both continuity proofs and the Hausdorff target.
explanation.author: Codex companion

nodes.title: 08ZH: closed fiber product
nodes.claim: Let \(f:X\to Z\) and \(g:Y\to Z\) be continuous maps of topological spaces, with \(Z\) Hausdorff. Then \(X\times_ZY\) is closed in \(X\times Y\).

explanation.text: The diagonal route uses the closed diagonal, continuity of \(h\), and the inverse-image identity jointly. The Lean route applies the closed-equalizer lemma to the two coordinate composites and unfolds the fiber product definition.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Apply 08ZE to the Hausdorff space Z.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Compose f with the first product projection.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Compose g with the second product projection.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: A map to a product is continuous when both coordinate maps are continuous.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Expand membership of the diagonal and the fiber product.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Take the inverse image of the closed diagonal under h, then use the set identity.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Apply Mathlib isClosed_eq with source X × Y and target Z.
explanation.author: Codex companion

explanation.text: Unfold fibreProduct; its defining predicate is the equality defining the closed equalizer.
explanation.author: Codex companion
